response.rationale: A is the hive itself, the thing inspections are recorded against (InspectionRepository.findByHive takes a hiveId). B is a hive scale, a separate weighing device: ScaleService calls ScaleRepository.findBySerial and WeightReadingRepository.findBySerialBetween, so a scale has its own serial number and weight readings. Scales are also looked up by hive (ScaleRepository.findByHive, HiveRepository.findById), which means a scale is linked to a hive. It is not another name for the hive.
